notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR10: each execution of a debugging section has the special register DEBUG-ITEM with the printed implicit description (DEBUG-LINE X(6), DEBUG-NAME X(30), DEBUG-SUB-1..3 S9999 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, the single-space FILLERs, DEBUG-CONTENTS X(n)). Runtime DebugItem holds those members at those widths, ImplicitRegisters.ActivateDebugRegisters declares them when a debugging section binds under the switch, and PlaceRenderer.DebugRead maps each member reference to the register. Probes at --std 85: FUNCTION LENGTH(DEBUG-ITEM) 86 and LENGTH(DEBUG-CONTENTS) 30 (6+1+30+1+5+1+5+1+5+1+30), the FILLERs at offsets 7 and 38 are spaces, a group MOVE of DEBUG-ITEM lands each member, the witness reads DEBUG-SUB-1..3 of a three-level reference as numbers; DEBUG-ITEM as a user data-name is a reserved word (COBOL0901), a reference outside a debugging section is refused (COBOL6442), and the register is refused from 2002 on.

next.reason: 1985: "Associated with each execution of a debugging section is the special register DEBUG-ITEM"; 2023: "USE statement rules cover only exception conditions, I-O and BEFORE REPORTING forms; no USE FOR DEBUGGING or DEBUG-ITEM". The 2023 USE statement candidates give exception, I-O and report forms only. None describes debugging sections or the DEBUG-ITEM special register, so the Debug feature is dropped.
